risks.risk: Wrong part type (photos look like a full engine/drivetrain assembly rather than a gearbox alone).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the gearbox only (bellhousing/gearbox casing) with any casting numbers/labels visible, plus a photo showing it separated from the engine.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed gearbox-only (worst case: treat as engine/drivetrain scrap value or non-matching part until proven).

risks.risk: Incompatible fitment (GMC Sierra V8 years/trim can use different transmissions/gear ratios and mounting patterns).
risks.proof: Ask for the gearbox casting/part number close-up and the vehicle details plate (or transmission code) from the donor vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incompatible (worst case: buyer must return/repair; treat as not guaranteed fit).

risks.risk: Unknown internal condition (no evidence of shifting, fluid condition, or leaks).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the gearbox being tested (shifts through gears) or at least photos of fluid level/condition and any leak points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs overhaul.

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage (unknown if it was dropped or has broken mounts/shafts).
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of input/output shafts, mounting ears, and any broken teeth/tears on housings.

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of the gearbox casing with readable casting/part numbers (input/output side and bellhousing side).
Send a photo showing the gearbox separated from the engine (confirm it is gearbox-only).

Send photos of any transmission code/label from the donor vehicle (or the transmission tag).
